pregame.pressurePoint: Oregon State deep passing vs Colorado State secondary. Oregon State is No. 24 of 138 in pass explosiveness (1.75). Colorado State ranks No. 104 at limiting explosive passes (1.66). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Colorado State does not keep the lid on. Oregon State will take shots, and the market total may be underpriced if they land. Watch the first deep shot. If it connects, Colorado State changes shells and the run game opens.

edges.why: Oregon State is No. 24 of 138 in pass explosiveness (1.75). Colorado State ranks No. 104 at limiting explosive passes (1.66). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Colorado State does not keep the lid on. Oregon State will take shots, and the market total may be underpriced if they land.

Oregon State is No. 58 of 138 in line yards per carry (3.20). Colorado State ranks No. 128 at the line of scrimmage (3.40). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. Oregon State should win first contact more often than not, which makes every down shorter.

Colorado State is No. 42 of 138 in passing-downs success (36%). Oregon State ranks No. 91 on passing downs (30%). A real edge, not a lock. Colorado State converts the long downs Oregon State needs to win. A third-and-8 is not a stop here.

Colorado State is No. 86 in rush success rate (43%) and Oregon State is No. 63 against the run (40%). Strength on strength. Neither side has shown it can impose the run on a unit this good. The first stuffed series tells you who blinks.
